I don’t have the ability to switch logins or profiles on your phone—my tools only work with the profile you’re currently signed into on this session, and there’s no way for me to control app sign‑in on your device.

On your phone, you should be able to switch to the loan‑only profile like this (exact wording may differ slightly by bank/app):

1. Open the bank app (if it’s already open, stay there).
2. Look for:
   - A “Profile” or user icon, or
   - A “More” / “Menu” / “Settings” button.
3. Tap it and look for:
   - “Sign Out” or “Log Out”, or
   - “Switch User” / “Change Profile” / “Other Accounts”.
4. Sign in with the username/password for your loan‑only login.
5. Once in, go to “Accounts” → “Loans” and tap your loan to see the balance.

If you tell me what options you see at the bottom or top of your app screen (e.g., the names of the tabs or buttons), I can tailor these steps more precisely. And once you’re viewing the loan details, I can help you interpret the balance, payoff amount, or set up a payoff plan. </action>
